{"consolidated_memory":"## Cache Miss Storm Incidents in build/bazel/BUILD.bazel

Recurring problem: cache miss storm in the build graph in build/bazel/BUILD.bazel. All incidents share:
- Reproduction: build twice with no source change
- Signal: rebuild of targets that should have been cached
- All work done on the build system side in the same corner of the file with shared context

### Occasion 1: [2026-02-19]
- Trigger: Turned up only after the client had already retried once
- Root cause: Mutable default argument shared across calls
- Result: 29 duplicate rows a day stopped being written
- Fix: Made the default empty and built the value per call
- PR: #2283 on branch fix/cache-miss-storm-1

### Occasion 2: [2026-07-02]
- Trigger: Turned up only for traffic arriving through the corporate proxy
- Root cause: Clock skew between the two hosts
- Result: The nightly rollup matched the source counts for 76 days running
- Fix: Switched the deadline to a monotonic clock
- PR: #2533 on branch fix/cache-miss-storm-2

### Occasion 3: [2026-07-19]
- Trigger: Turned up only for tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys
- Root cause: Connection pool exhaustion under burst load
- Result: The job finished in 50 minutes instead of 7 hours
- Fix: Raised the pool ceiling and put a bounded wait queue in front of it
- PR: #4901 on branch fix/cache-miss-storm-3
- Stack: Starlark; covering check is the remote cache hit rate check in CI

### Occasion 4: [2026-08-11]
- Trigger: Turned up only after a rolling restart of the fleet
- Root cause: Floating point rounding in the money path
- Result: Error rate dropped from 8.0 percent to under 4 per ten thousand
- Fix: Moved the arithmetic to integer minor units
- PR: #6834 on branch fix/cache-miss-storm-4"}
